description: This source file defines a set of asynchronous command functions for a routing system related to equity ownership data. It provides endpoints for major holders, institutional ownership, insider trading, share statistics, Form 13F filings, and government trades, each returning data via the OBBject model based on query parameters.

methods.name: major_holders
methods.description: Fetches data about major holders of a company's stock over time.

methods.name: institutional
methods.description: Retrieves net statistics on institutional ownership based on filings.

methods.name: insider_trading
methods.description: Provides data about trading activity by company's management and directors.

methods.name: share_statistics
methods.description: Fetches share float data for a given company.

methods.name: form_13f
methods.description: Retrieves SEC Form 13F filings for institutional investment managers.

methods.name: government_trades
methods.description: Obtains government transaction data, including Senate and House data.
